JUST IN: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) welcomes the appointment of former Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen. Nicolas Torre III as the new MMDA General Manager.

In an official statement, the agency expresses its full support to the decision of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. in his trust for Gen. Torre, whose extensive experience in public service and law enforcement is expected to further strengthen the MMDA’s mandate in traffic management and public safety, among others, across Metro Manila.

MMDA Chairman Atty. Don Artes says, "Gen. Torre is a welcome addition to the MMDA family. I am sure he will be a big help to the agency." 

The MMDA has also extended its sincere appreciation to former General Manager Procopio Lipana for his dedication and valuable contributions to MMDA for more than three years. 

The agency says they remain committed to continuing its mission of ensuring safe, efficient, and orderly mobility and development in Metro Manila with the appointment of Gen. Torre.

𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂 𝐀𝐃𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐎𝐑𝐘

In view of the programme of Christmas Feast celebrations – 2025 at           LB Stadium by the Hon’ble Chief Minister, the following traffic restrictions are likely to be implemented on need basis on 20.12.2025 between 5 p.m. and 10 p.m.

The traffic will be either stopped or diverted at the following places/routes on need basis:
1.Traffic coming from AR Petrol Pump Junction towards BJR Statue will be diverted at A.R. Petrol Pump towards Nampally Railway Station.
2.Traffic coming from Basheerbagh towards A.R. Petrol Pump will be diverted at BJR Statue towards SBI, Abids and Nampally Station road.  
3.Traffic coming from Sujatha School lane towards Khan Lateef Khan building will be diverted at Sujatha School junction towards Nampally.  
Junctions to be avoided between 5 p.m. to 10 p.m. on 20.12.2025:  
Lakdi Ka Pool, Iqbal Minar, Ravindra Bharathi, Hyderabad Traffic Police Junction, Basheerbagh, BJR Statue Circle, SBI Gunfoundry, A.R. Petrol Pump,                 KLK Building and Liberty.

RTC Buses:  
The RTC Buses plying from Ravindra Bharathi towards BJR Statue will be diverted at A.R. Petrol Pump towards Nampally Railway Station depending on the traffic situation as per the need.

Citizens are requested to take alternative routes to reach their destinations and avoid the above routes/junctions during the above specified timings and co-operate with the Traffic Police.  In case of any inconvenience in commuting, please contact the Hyderabad Traffic Police Helpline 9010203626
